ballistic_vs_thrust — DRIVE ball op

• Data kinds: signal × points × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ballistic_vs_thrust(t, p, bp: 'dict', *, iters: 'int' = 20, dt: 'float' = 0.001) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import ballistics; ballistics.ballistic_vs_thrust(t, p, bp: 'dict', *, iters: 'int' = 20, dt: 'float' = 0.001) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("ballistic_vs_thrust"))

Usage

Fits both "gravity + drag" (drag_fit) and "gravity + drag + constant specific thrust" (thrust_fit) to the same trajectory and returns the AIC difference (aic_from_rss) ΔAIC = AIC_ballistic − AIC_thrust. Returns {"ballistic", "thrust"} (the two fits) plus "aic_ballistic", "aic_thrust", "delta_aic", "thrust_norm". No verdict is returned (the imgforensics convention): read it by parsimony — the thrust model has 3 more parameters and lowers RSS slightly even on pure noise, so unless it wins by more than the penalty 2Δk the simpler (ballistic) model is kept. Noise-only ΔAIC scatters around −2Δk with a χ²(Δk) width, and because the thrust fit starts from the ballistic solution ΔAIC ≥ −2Δk holds. The customary "decisive" value is 10 (false positives well below 1 %), but no threshold is bundled; the caller decides.

Empty input (t with 0 elements) raises ValueError.
